meta.title: Contact | Sefinek
meta.description: Have questions or need help? Contact Sefinek by email or Discord.
meta.keywords: contact sefinek, email, discord, github issues, support

heading: Get in touch
intro: Have questions or need help? Feel free to write! I usually reply within 24-48 hours.
emailDescription: The best place for detailed questions, collaboration proposals and bug reports. I keep Thunderbird running all the time, so you usually won't have to wait long for a reply.
discordDescription: A good place for quick questions, casual conversations and support from others. I also share updates and changes to my projects here.
githubDescription: Browse my repositories and find the one relevant to your question. A bug, a feature idea or a technical question - open an issue directly in the appropriate project.
statusDescription: Before writing about an outage, check the status page first - it updates automatically and usually shows whether the problem is already known.

cta.title: Just want to say hello?
cta.description: Write anytime. I read everything and try to reply to everyone.

label: Contact
